transcript.answer: Pull request #475, "Hand the resolved fallback to HAL Engine, and refuse fallbacks it cannot serve". It was merged on 2026-10-23 and closes issue #474. Before it, `buildEngine` passed `createHalEngine` no `fallbackProviders`, which is the only setting HAL Engine fails over through. The PR passes the resolved fallback as the only `fallbackProviders` entry, or an empty list when `FALLBACK_MODEL_ID` is unset. It also makes startup fail for fallbacks that can't be served, such as non-mock ones. The earlier PR #438 (issue #179) had only checked the id against the allowlist and printed it in the startup line.
